available_assertion.objects: Any abelian variety A over a number field F, its dual, and an F-defined polarization lambda.
available_assertion.hypotheses: Characteristic zero, ell=5, and lambda a polarization; the published alternating assertion applies after algebraic closure.
available_assertion.quantifiers: For every such A,F,lambda and all Tate vectors and G_F elements.
available_assertion.parameter_range: ell=5; no condition on reduction at 5 or on the 5-part of deg(lambda).
available_assertion.uniformity: Canonical functorial pairing for each fixed A/F; no quantitative uniformity assertion.
available_assertion.constants: Multiplier epsilon_5. Nondegeneracy is over Q_5, regardless of the integral cokernel of T_5(lambda).
available_assertion.normalizations: Covariant Tate modules and the roots-of-unity Tate twist Q_5(1). The dual pairing is composed in the second factor with lambda.
available_assertion.exceptional_cases: A principal polarization and degree prime to 5 are unnecessary. Skew symmetry is alternating in characteristic zero. Pairing supply does not establish the separate two-copy identity.
available_assertion.limit_order: Take compatible prime-power torsion pairings, pass to Tate modules, tensor with Q_5, and compose with the isogeny lambda.
